## PRE-IAB: Rankings Ignored

![Before: Politicians have report cards showing how much good they do. Nobody looks at them. Everyone looks at the lobbyists with money instead.](utility-function-pre-iab.png){#fig-utility-pre-iab}

## POST-IAB: Rankings Operative

![After: Politicians have report cards that actually matter. Do good things, get good scores, get reelected. Like kindergarten, but with fewer finger paintings and more PACs.](utility-function-post-iab.png){#fig-utility-post-iab}

:::

The IAB mechanism does not require politicians to become better people or to care about social welfare intrinsically. It simply redirects their existing selfish utility maximization toward welfare-improving outcomes.

**Same selfish optimization, radically different equilibrium.** This is the core mechanism design contribution.
